text:
lee: Quick question — are we saving raw user prompts in staging request bodies? Need to trace a flaky eval.

maria-devex: We log request bodies for a short window in staging for debugging, but prompts should be redacted. Which endpoint?

lee: /v1/generate on the dev-proxy. grabbed a sample:

```
{"user_id":"u-123","prompt":"Summarize customer email: I had a bad experience with order #98765...","auth":"Bearer abcdef12345"}
```

sam-ops: That auth should already be replaced by proxy with `Authorization: <REDACTED>` but prompt field sometimes slips through if sampling_config=full.

natalie-privacy: We intentionally redact tokens and SSNs. Prompts are considered PII if they include personal data — we treat them case-by-case. For staging we use `PROMPT_SCRUB=on`.

lee: Is there a small regex we can run on logs to replace prompt contents? I can run on the one sample.

maria-devex: Use this quick scrub:

```
sed -E 's/("prompt"\s*:\s*")[^"]+(\")/\1[REDACTED_PROMPT]\2/g'
```

sam-ops: Also strip long sequences >200 chars: `jq '.prompt |= (if length>200 then "[REDACTED_LONG_PROMPT]" else . end)'

natalie-privacy: Approving staging scrub. For prod we need an internal change request + audit. @sam-ops can you open a PR and set the feature flag?

sam-ops: Will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452 — adding middleware to scrub prompt + header mask.

token-watch-bot: [automated] Detected header `Authorization` in logs — redaction rule applied.

lee: Thanks all. running scrub now and will report back if anything else shows up :thumbsup:
